note: Under tall pines on the west bank of the Housatonic River near Cornwall Bridge; sites 3-7 and 12-18, on the river side of the campground road, look through the trees to the river. Five sites (30, 31, 32, 55, 57) are posted at 20 ft. Cabins rent Fridays and Saturdays. No pets or alcohol. --Claude
